group_method.name: creator_plus_loc_sequence_guard
group_method.interpretation: conservative leakage guard inferred from creator and sequential LOC digital ids; not a recovered LOT, assignment, roll, process or scanner batch
group_method.source_basis: LOC states that each photographic assignment is usually given a block of sequential negatives.

location_recovery.status: predeclared after sequence-only grouping failed its independent-group gate
location_recovery.interpretation: creator plus caption-derived state or territory, with the sequence group retained as fallback when no location is recovered; not an exact assignment label

evaluation_contract.primary: leave-one-creator-out over creator groups with at least eight records
evaluation_contract.secondary: leave-one-location-guard-group-out over groups with at least three records; also report sequence-only sensitivity
evaluation_contract.scanner_out: not identifiable within this common LOC capture lane; must be evaluated on an independent real-film source
evaluation_contract.forbidden: random image split or treating sequence_guard_group as physical roll truth

claim_ceiling: real-film-derived archive scan look under creator and conservative sequence holdouts; no calibrated stock, physical-roll, process or scanner-setting claim
